Here's exactly how the September 17-19 weekend assignments and packet access work, and nothing beyond that:

- Aiko may provide morning care only — no evening or overnight shifts.
- Beth is the licensed nurse covering Friday evening (September 17). That's her only assignment in this window.
- Luis may drive only. He must never see drug names or diagnoses in any packet — keep his materials strictly to logistics and scheduling.
- The unverified temp helper is not authorized for any assignment or packet. Do not include them.

Regarding service hours: Saturday and Sunday evening service already has an unchanged confirmed service — do not touch it. That stands as is.

Each caregiver's packet will be limited to exactly what their role requires per the above. I won't approve any handoff packet until I see the exact assignments and the contents myself.
